evidence.quote: CALL transfer_to_human_agents({"summary": "Customer Yusuf Hernandez (email: yusuf.hernandez8836@example.com) is trying to exchange items from order #W0001234 but the order cannot be found in the system.

observed_facts: The agent successfully found the user ID via email in step 4-5.
The order ID #W0001234 provided by the user did not exist in the system, returning an error in step 9.
Instead of checking the user's details via `get_user_details` to find their actual orders (as seen in the reference run), the agent transferred the user to a human agent in step 22.
inference: The agent prematurely gave up and transferred the user instead of investigating the user's profile to discover the correct order ID (#W2466703).
This instruction/plan adherence failure directly caused the task to fail.
needs_verification: Whether the agent policy or available tools expected the agent to look up user details when an order ID is not found.
parsed.summary: The agent failed to investigate the user profile when the initial order lookup failed, prematurely transferring the user to a human agent instead of completing the exchange.
